purpose: Prevent real-but-wrong visuals from passing editorial QA.
principle: A visual is not approved merely because it is real, licensed or contains a related keyword. It must support the exact subject, entity and narration beat being published.

requiredChecks.EXACT_SUBJECT_VISUAL_PASS: The image/video materially depicts the exact company, person, product, operation, event, mechanism or factual context being discussed.
requiredChecks.NAMED_ENTITY_RECOGNIZABLE_PASS: When a named company/person/product is the subject, at least one primary visual must make that entity recognizable without relying on the caption.
requiredChecks.NARRATION_VISUAL_BEAT_MATCH_PASS: Every narrated beat must be paired with the corresponding entity/mechanism/context; generic proxy imagery is not sufficient.
requiredChecks.NEGATIVE_CONTEXT_MISMATCH_PASS: Reject visuals whose actual context changes the meaning: protests, fires, accidents, unrelated historical events, demonstrations or crises cannot be used as neutral company imagery.
requiredChecks.TEMPORAL_RELEVANCE_PASS: Historical imagery is allowed only when the narration is historical or the image is clearly labeled archival. Current-strategy stories must not be illustrated mainly with unrelated vintage products.
requiredChecks.RIGHTS_PROVENANCE_PASS: Source and rights must be known and acceptable.
requiredChecks.SAFE_AREA_V2_PASS: All important visual and text elements remain inside the mobile-safe area.
requiredChecks.CC_LOWER_BAND_PASS: Narration captions stay in a dedicated lower band, maximum two lines, never covering the primary visual.

releaseRule: Publisher mutation to autoPublish=true is forbidden unless every scheduled asset has an explicit PASS for all applicable checks above.
